import { ssrRenderSlot as _ssrRenderSlot, ssrRenderAttrs as _ssrRenderAttrs } from "@vue/server-renderer"
import { mergeProps as _mergeProps } from "vue"

function ssrRender(_ctx, _push, _parent, _attrs) {
  _push(`<div${_ssrRenderAttrs(_mergeProps({ class: "layout" }, _attrs))} data-v-layout>`)
  _ssrRenderSlot(_ctx.$slots, "default", {}, null, _push, _parent, "data-v-layout-s")
  _push(`</div>`)
}

const _sfc_main = {}
_sfc_main.ssrRender = ssrRender
export default _sfc_main
